remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled two-bedroom, two-bath modular home located in a prime Westport community. Set within a modular home park, this property offers a excellent location just minutes to shopping, dining, and the train - ideal for commuters and anyone seeking convenience. Inviting open floor plan with luxury vinyl plank flooring, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and the ease of an in-unit washer and dryer. Both bedrooms are generously sized with two full bathrooms for added comfort. Tenant pays all utilities, credit check, responsible for some grounds maintenance (snow removal sidewalk, front and back entrances, parking spaces). HOA is responsible for exterior grounds maintenance, trash removal, and snow removal of roads. Ample yard space for outdoor relaxation and everyday living. No smoking. Ask about pet policy. Unfurnished.
